import {h,hydrate,render,Component} from '/frameworks/preact.mjs';
export {h};
export const lifecycle={mounted:0,unmounted:0};
let app;
export function mount(view,state,root){class App extends Component{constructor(){super();this.state=state;app=this;}render(){return view(this.state);}componentDidMount(){lifecycle.mounted++;}componentWillUnmount(){lifecycle.unmounted++;}}hydrate(h(App),root);}
export function update(state){app.setState(state);}
export async function flush(){await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();}
export function unmount(root){render(null,root);}
